LightningComponentBundle.description: Conversational chat with AAO agents: session threads, live progress, tool activity.

property.name: agentDeveloperName
property.label: Pinned Agent
property.description: Agent_Definition__mdt DeveloperName. When set, the agent picker is hidden and all chats use this agent.

property.name: showToolActivity
property.label: Show Agent Activity
property.description: Show the tool steps the agent runs on its way to an answer, as activity chips in the thread and by name in the progress indicator. Uncheck for an audience that only wants the answer - the chat then shows a plain 'Thinking...' while it works.
